title: Map the order module's failures to API errors

blocks.text: An ordering service's mobile app decides what to show from the API's error responses. The order module's developers improve their exception messages often, to make the logs easier to read, and those messages hold customer ids and the names of internal risk rules. After the last release the app started showing "Something went wrong" for out-of-stock items, and a security review flagged a response that named a risk rule.
Finish `toResponse` in `src/main/java/practice/OrderApi.java`, using the statuses its comment documents. About five lines.

cases.says: each error code gets its documented HTTP status and its name as the response code
two failures with the same code and different messages get the same response
the response carries none of the internal values the exception's message holds

origin.section: Clients Branch on an Error Code, Never on the Message

concepts: An API maps failures by an error-code field, never by message text, and returns its own text rather than the exception's message.
